rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises due to an unsafe condition (icy walkway), which is a textbook liability claim.
claim_summary: A neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped on the policyholder's icy front walkway during an ice storm last week and broke her wrist. Parents are seeking coverage for medical bills. This is a high-severity pediatric injury claim on the premises.

case_facts.description: slipped and fell on icy walkway; broke wrist
